The US FDA expanded the use of Eli Lilly's
Olumiant (baricitinib) for severe alopecia areata to include children 12 years and older.

was based on 36-week data from the adolescent cohort of the phase 3 BRAVE-AA-PEDS study that showed those 80% or more scalp hair coverage was achieved in 42% of patients treated with Olumiant 4 mg and 27% treated with the 2 mg dosage, compared to 5% for those on placebo.
The JAK inhibitor is also approved for adults with rheumatoid arthritis.

title: Eli Lilly's Olumiant receives expanded alopecia indication for children 12 and up
